comment: M5-018A: the system test room source row. Targets spawn by enemy_id (DA_<id> under /Game/UEMMO/Enemy/Definitions) with the configured max_health, target reaction policy_id (DA_Target_<id> from the M5-008 generated assets: normal/heavy/boss are the M5-003 sample rows) and room-local location. Change a value and reload the map - the room follows this table, not class code. vehicle_spawns is the future vehicle list: legal only while empty until the vehicle segment (M5-037+) implements the capability; a non-empty list refuses with an explicit not-implemented error and never fabricates a stand-in.
